subject: Trial alignment and owner rollcall - AquaTech pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Paul Sweeney <paul.sweeney@aquatech.com>, Lisa Chen <l.chen@aquatech.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Trial alignment and owner rollcall - AquaTech pilot

Thanks for the time today, Paul and Lisa — good conversation. I promised a concise recap and a request to confirm owners so we can lock the trial schedule. Attaching a short success-criteria workbook and a suggested evaluation plan.

High-level proposal (please confirm):
- Trial window: 2 weeks (provisioning week + 10 days evaluation) — target kickoff wk of 9/22.
- Success criteria (draft, see attached):
  • 95th pct latency < 600ms for typical 512-token requests
  • End-to-end throughput to support 10 concurrent analyst sessions
  • No data exfiltration incidents; audit logs enabled and retained 90 days
  • Automated scoring on the provided prompt set: >= 0.78 pass rate (per scoring doc)
- Minimum test assets required from AquaTech: sample prompt set, sample payloads, network ingress requirements, procurement contact for PO/terms.

Owner rollcall we need from your side (please reply inline):
- Infrastructure / network access (who will provision firewall/VPN and who owns on-call?)
- App owner (owner for integration and test data ingestion)
- Security contact (SOC/compliance checkpoint and evidence owner)
- Procurement contact (PO / contract signer)

Internal Redwood owners (for visibility):
- Marissa Cole — engagement lead (program manager / customer success)
- Karthik Iyer — solutions / infra architect (will coordinate sandbox + Dedicated config)
- Laura Bennett — procurement & contracting (handles PO / SOW cadence)
- Stephanie Nguyen — customer reliability lead (test orchestration & runbook)

Next steps requested: please reply with owner names & emails for the bullets above by EOD Thu 9/17 so we can finalize the kickoff invite and pre-provision infra.

Attachments: [attachment: POC-success-criteria.xlsx (12KB)]

Thanks,
Marissa

marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0121

Subject: Re: Trial alignment and owner rollcall - AquaTech pilot

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the file. Quick answers from our side (updating owners):
- Infrastructure / network: Lisa Chen (Platform Lead) — l.chen@aquatech.com. She will handle VPN and firewall changes; attaching network diagram.
- App owner: Raj Mehta (Data Product Lead) — raj.mehta@aquatech.com (primary for ingestion).
- Security contact: Sarah Gomez (InfoSec Manager) — s.gomez@aquatech.com. She will run the initial questionnaire and provide contact for audit logs.
- Procurement: Tyler Nguyen (Procurement) — t.nguyen@aquatech.com (will need SOW + PO template).

We reviewed the success criteria and the latency target is reasonable. A couple of caveats:
- We will need dedicated egress IPs whitelisted from our side for the sandbox.
- Can Redwood host the model variant with quantization profile Q4_1 for cost predictability?

Proposed kickoff: Tue 9/22 10:00am PT — 60m to cover provisioning checklist + data handoff.

Attachment: [AquaTech-network-diagram.pdf (58KB)]

Paul

paul.sweeney@aquatech.com | +1 (617) 555-0198

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Paul Sweeney <paul.sweeney@aquatech.com>, Lisa Chen <l.chen@aquatech.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial alignment and owner rollcall - AquaTech pilot

Thanks Paul — appreciate the clarity. A few internal clarifications from Redwood and a proposed RACI we can use as a starting point.

What Redwood will provision / own for the trial:
- Serving runtime and model hosting (Dedicated sandbox cluster) — Redwood (karthik_iyer).
- KV/prefix cache management for test workloads — Redwood ops.
- Token-level telemetry and retention (90d) — Redwood (stephanie_nguyen to configure).
- On-call for infra-related incidents during the window — Redwood escalation team (priyom_das listed as first contact).

What we need from AquaTech:
- Network egress IPs to whitelist / VPN creds (Lisa).
- Test prompt set and sample payloads (Raj).
- Procurement PO or short SOW (Tyler).
- Security questionnaire responses and required evidence (Sarah).

Proposed RACI (draft):
- Infrastructure provisioning: Responsible = Lisa (AquaTech), Accountable = Karthik (Redwood), Consulted = Paul, Informed = Marissa
- App integration & ingestion: Responsible = Raj (AquaTech), Accountable = Stephanie (Redwood), Consulted = Karthik, Informed = Marissa
- Security & audit evidence: Responsible = Sarah (AquaTech), Accountable = Karthik, Consulted = Laura, Informed = Marissa
- Procurement / contract sign: Responsible = Tyler (AquaTech), Accountable = Laura (Redwood), Consulted = Marissa, Informed = Paul

Open questions for AquaTech:
1) Can Lisa share the firewall rule window (preferred maintenance hours) to schedule any inbound exceptions?
2) Tyler — what is your PO lead time and any template requirements?
3) Sarah — any nonstandard audit evidence required beyond access logs and TLS certs?

Links: MSA draft (internal): https://www.docusign.net/prepare/abc-POC-MSA

I will start the sandbox build on 9/20 once Lisa confirms the IP range.

— Karthik

Paul / Tyler — looping in procurement next steps from Redwood's side. To keep this light for a short pilot we generally do a short-form SOW + PO for the reserved sandbox capacity. What I need from AquaTech to expedite:
- PO template or the company purchase order number to attach to the invoice.
- Billing contact (name + email).
- Any mandatory contract language (data residency / indemnity) that procurement needs to include.

Docs I'll send once I have the PO contact:
- Short SOW (1 page) for sandbox capacity & professional services (link to draft after PO)
- Invoice template and payment terms (Net 30 by default)
- If needed, temporary NDA addendum (if you want earlier access to pre-release features)

Related: Please review the DocuSign MSA link here so we can get signatures before provisioning: https://www.docusign.net/prepare/abc-POC-MSA

Happy to be on the kickoff; suggest Laura (procurement) and Stephanie (test lead) join the provisioning call.

Thanks,
